content.what_it_is: Legacy v2.1 variant of the FUNWAVE-TVD flux module (first line 'start some modification based on Choi' L1; BSD header L2-45 mislabels the file 'FILE main.F' at L4). Same architecture as fluxes.F but before the 2016 scheme additions: only two HIGH_ORDER options and no MLP/WENO/EtaScreen. 14 program units. FLUXES (L53-78): HIGH_ORDER 'FOU' -> CONSTRUCTION_HO else DelxyFun+CONSTRUCTION, each followed by WAVE_SPEED (L57-68); CONSTR 'HLL' -> FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL else FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L70-74); then BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L76). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L89-100): P,Fx,Gx,Q,Fy,Gy=0.5*(R+L) averaging (predictor only per L83). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L111-122): six HLL calls (P,Q,Fx,Fy,Gx,Gy with EtaRx/EtaRy, HUx/HUy, HVx/HVy conserved pairs, L115-120). HLL (L132-155): FOUT=FL if SL>=0, FR if SR<=0, else HLL middle flux (SR*FL-SL*FR+SL*SR*(UR-UL))/(SR-SL) with SMALL substitution when |SR-SL|<SMALL (L140-151). DelxyFun (L165-183): van-Leer slopes of Eta,U,V,HU,HV in x (L170-174) and y (L177-181) — no EtaScreen variant. DelyFun (L193-237)/DelxFun (L247-290): harmonic van Leer limiter DOUT=(TMP1*|TMP2|+|TMP1|*TMP2)/(|TMP1|+|TMP2|), zero when |TMP1|+|TMP2|<SMALL (L216-223, L270-276), one-sided boundary rows (L227-235, L280-288); non-CARTESIAN backward slope uses DY(I,J-1)/DX(I-1,J) (L214, L268). WAVE_SPEED (L306-393): identical Zhou et al. (2001) formulation to fluxes.F — x-interface SQR_PHI_L/R=sqrt(g|HxL/R|), SQR_PHI_S, U_S, SxL=min(UL-SQR_PHI_L,U_S-SQR_PHI_S), SxR=max(...) over interior (L323-332), ghost strips copied (L335-355); y-interface SyL/SyR (L358-367) with ghost copies (L371-391); history notes Steve Brandt and Dmitry M1/N1 bug (L300-303). CONSTRUCTION (L405-633, ykchoi additions 08/06/2015 DelxU4 terms and 09/07/2015 MASK9u/MASK9v L401-402): MASK9u/v allocation and ghost-column extension (L415-422); CONSTRUCT_X of U,V,HU,HV,Eta (L426-430); HxL/R=EtaRxL/R+Depthx (L431-432); CARTESIAN DISPERSION constructs U4 and V4 via DelxFun+CONSTRUCT_X (L435-443); flux assembly identical in form to fluxes.F — PL/PR with Gamma1*MASK9u*Hx*U4x (L451-456; ZALPHA L462-466; plain L469-470), FxL/FxR advective+hydrostatic (L478-486 CARTESIAN, L491-499 ZALPHA, L502-505 plain), GxL/GxR Shi et al. 2012 form (L513-521) or GxL=HxL*UxL*VxL*Gamma3 (L525-526); y-direction CONSTRUCT_Y of U,V,HV,HU,Eta (L531-535), V4/U4 (L540-548), QL/QR (L553-571), FyL/FyR Shi 2012 form (L582-590) or non-CARTESIAN FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL*Gamma3 (L593-594, Gamma3 twice), GyL/GyR (L600-627); deallocate (L631). CONSTRUCT_Y (L645-691)/CONSTRUCT_X (L703-748): kappa-scheme MUSCL reconstruction OutL(I,J)=Vin(I,J-1)+0.25*DY*((1-kappa)*Din(I,J-1)+(1+kappa)*Din(I,J-1)) and OutR=Vin(I,J)-0.25*DY*((1+kappa)*Din(I,J)+(1-kappa)*Din(I,J)) (L661-669, L719-727) — both kappa terms multiply the same Din so the expression reduces to 0.5*DY*Din regardless of Kappa; boundary extrapolation and OutL(1)=OutR(1), OutR(end)=OutL(end) closures (L674-689, L732-746). CONSTRUCTION_HO (L761-968, Yamamoto et al. 1998, header L752-758): CONSTRUCT_HO_X of U,V,HU,HV,Eta (L781-785), U4/V4 when DISPERSION (L791-796; ZALPHA L819-824), and the same PL/FxL/GxL and QL/GyL/FyL assembly as CONSTRUCTION (L801-966). CONSTRUCT_HO_X (L979-1082)/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L1094-1198): 4th-order compact scheme — triple capped-minmod DVP1/2/3 from successive differences (L1003-1017), dry-cell lower-order and zero-gradient fallbacks (L1019-1046), Din=TXP2-(1/6)*(DVP3-2*DVP2+DVP1) (L1048, y L1163), interface values OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+(1/6)*(TXP1+2*TXP2), OutR=Vin(I,J)-(1/6)*(TXP3+2*TXP4) from 4x-limited Din pairs (L1055-1078 with 'HUGE bug ... 12 should versus 43, fixed' note L1065; y L1171-1194, note L1181). VANLEER_LIMITER (L1211-1225) and MINMOD_LIMITER (L1227-1241) optional-argument functions, unused in active code (calls commented L221,L274).

unresolved: This file duplicates most of fluxes.F at an earlier revision (v2.1 per filename): no MLP/WENO/CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod schemes, no UseEtaScreen branches, FLUXES has only FOU/default paths (L57-68); which file is compiled is decided by the build system, not visible here
Same Gamma3-squared anomaly as fluxes.F: non-CARTESIAN FyL/FyR=Gamma3*Hy*Uy*Vy*Gamma3 (L593-594) vs GxL=HxL*UxL*VxL*Gamma3 (L525-526)

In CONSTRUCT_X/CONSTRUCT_Y the kappa-scheme expressions apply (1-kappa) and (1+kappa) weights to the same Din value (L661-669, L719-727), so they algebraically reduce to the 2nd-order 0.5*D*Din form and the Kappa argument has no effect — precursor of the later ykchoi observation ('kappa is meaningless') coded explicitly in fluxes.F
Header block mislabeled 'FILE main.F' (L4) and first line records an in-progress modification note (L1)

FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL locals SR,SL,FL,FR,UL,UR (L113) unused; DelxU4/DelxV4/DelyV4/DelyU4 declared in CONSTRUCTION (L410-411) are used only inside the DISPERSION branch, and CONSTRUCTION_HO declares DelxU4/DelyV4 (L765-766) never used
HLL degenerate case divides by SMALL rather than limiting (L146-147), as in fluxes.F
